# BotToBook

> BotToBook is a free browser-based viewer for Character.AI data exports. It opens the password-protected export ZIP or message.json on the user's device and can turn the chats into a PDF, EPUB or HTML book. Nothing is uploaded. Viewing and text export are free; full books cost $4.99 once. Not affiliated with Character Technologies, Inc.

## Key facts about the Character.AI data export (checked November 2026)
- Delivery: An emailed link to a ZIP. Character.AI says 3–4 weeks; the link is valid for 7 days.
- ZIP password: The account's email address, in lowercase.
- Layout: A folder named after your username, with a data folder inside.
- user.json: Your account profile.
- character.json: Only characters you created: name, greeting, definition.
- message.json: Every message from all your chats, in one list.
- Fields per message: chat_id, candidate_id, raw_content, create_time (microsecond precision).
- Not included: Who wrote each message, and the name of the character you chatted with.

## Pages
- [Tool: Character.AI chat to PDF and EPUB](https://bottobook.yansquared.com/)
- [Character.AI export ZIP password](https://bottobook.yansquared.com/character-ai-export-zip-password/): The Character.AI export ZIP password is your account's email address in lowercase. Why it fails, and how to open the ZIP in your browser without an unzip app.
- [How to open a Character.AI export](https://bottobook.yansquared.com/how-to-open-character-ai-export/): Step by step: request your Character.AI export, unlock the ZIP with your email in lowercase, and read message.json as real conversations in a browser viewer.
- [Character.AI chat to PDF](https://bottobook.yansquared.com/character-ai-chat-to-pdf/): Save Character.AI chats as a PDF book with a cover, contents, a chapter per chat and page numbers. Works from the official export, in your browser, on phone or computer.
- [Character.AI chats to Kindle](https://bottobook.yansquared.com/character-ai-to-kindle/): Read your Character.AI chats on a Kindle, Kobo or Apple Books: turn the official export into an EPUB with a chapter per chat, then send it with Send to Kindle.
- [Character.AI message.json format](https://bottobook.yansquared.com/character-ai-message-json/): What's inside a Character.AI data export: user.json, character.json and message.json, the fields in each message, what's missing, and how viewers rebuild your chats.
- [Privacy and refunds](https://bottobook.yansquared.com/privacy/)
